svg.text: a hole in the wall: a tunnel too low for the Counter
One structure, wall to wall. The post in the middle, the frame rising round it in six terraces. Nothing else.
2 at the court, 12 at the wall
a tunnel in the wall, then the PLAY ZONE gate
Ring of frame; the number is its floors. Its top is a terrace
Stair aisle up the terraces, wide enough for the Counter
Tube slide down the steps, one colour each
The way in: the only straight line in the level
FOUR WAYS OUT AFTER THE THIRD TOUCH
climb to the top; the slide carries you out through the wall
the gate opens again; the tunnel is too low for the Counter
the post sinks and leaves a chute, in the middle of everything
one of four doors high in the wall unlocks, a different one each time
100 studs: about 6 seconds at a walk, 4 at a sprint
